lessons.title: The Curse of Dimensionality 🧙‍♂️
lessons.description: Understand why too many features can break models and how to think geometrically about high‑dimensional space.

lessons.title: Advanced Feature Engineering 🔧
lessons.description: Go beyond basic scaling/encoding: target encoding, datetime features, text vectors, and polynomial combinations.

lessons.description: Remove noise and redundancy with variance thresholds, mutual information, and recursive feature elimination.

lessons.description: Supervised dimensionality reduction, stunning visualisations, and rules of thumb for picking the right technique.
